about_the_game:
Robbie 2 is an expansive open-world fantasy RPG with satisfying combat, strategic elements, and epic boss battles. Traverse vibrant forests, ancient dungeons, snowy mountains, and forgotten ruins. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden lore, forge powerful gear, and experience captivating quests.

As you explore, you'll encounter a rich tapestry of stories and characters, forming alliances and uncovering hidden treasures. Solve intricate puzzles, conquer epic bosses, and unravel ancient mysteries to gain powerful rewards. Each challenge you face will test your skills and strategy, ensuring a rewarding and immersive experience.

Craft your best equipment, learn new abilities, solve puzzles, uncover hidden lore, forge powerful gear, and complete a plethora of quests.


Features

Satisfying Combat

Master thrilling combat mechanics with a variety of weapons. Engage in intense battles and face formidable foes in dynamic encounters.

Learn New Abilities

Unlock new skills to enhance your character. Improve combat techniques, and develop unique abilities that suit your playstyle.

Crafting

Gather resources and forge powerful gear to aid your journey. Craft weapons, armor, and items to create the ultimate arsenal and prepare for any challenge.

Explore

Venture into a vast open world filled with vibrant forests, ancient dungeons, snowy mountains, and forgotten ruins. Discover hidden treasures, encounter diverse characters, and uncover rich lore.

Puzzles

Solve intricate puzzles to unlock secrets and progress through the game. Use your wits to navigate complex environments, access hidden areas, and unravel ancient mysteries.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-750 or equivalent
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-750 or equivalent
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2050 RTX or equivalent
